validation_reason: Oracle reproduced the vulnerability and detected the maintainer fix.

vulnerable.evidence: Boundaries are digit-only with dash prefix across samples, consistent with unsafe Math.random-based generation. sample=--------------------------395598612257842750112495 charset=-0123456789

fixed.evidence: Boundary generation includes broader/non-digit character patterns; unsafe predictable format not observed. sample=--------------------------29d8a2c19e6d73c2093ffe16

oracle.explanation: This oracle validates the public FormData flow first by creating a form, appending a field, and reading its boundary. Only after that succeeds does it mark operation_completed=true. It then probes boundary generation across multiple instances and flags exploitation when every boundary matches a digit-only format with dash prefix (the vulnerable pattern associated with non-cryptographic randomness). Patched behavior is expected to produce boundaries that do not all match that restricted pattern, causing exploit_succeeded=false while keeping operation_completed=true.
